name: Mage Quarter
summary: Across the canals in southwestern Stormwind, Mage Quarter draws the kingdom's spellcasters. The Wizard's Sanctum rises above its streets, while shops supply their craft. The quarter also holds sorcery the kingdom's high conjurers forbid.

sections.title: Sanctum of the Arcane
sections.body: Bridges from Cathedral Square and the Trade District lead into Mage Quarter, where the Alliance's mystic needs are met. Human and allied spellcasters gather around the Wizard's Sanctum to study arcane magic and train apprentices. Nearby shops sell tailoring cloth, reagents, alchemical supplies, and enchanted staves. This close-knit district serves research and the kingdom's defense.

sections.title: Secrets Beneath the Surface
sections.body: Some magic in Mage Quarter falls beyond the approval of the kingdom's high conjurers. The Blue Recluse gives scholars a quiet refuge, while The Slaughtered Lamb hides a coven of warlocks in its underground crypts. There, unseen by the city guard and Cathedral Square, demonologists study forbidden fel rites and bind otherworldly beings. They keep to these hidden rooms beneath a quarter that tolerates strange magic.

faq.answer: The Wizard's Sanctum is the tower that dominates Mage Quarter. It houses Stormwind's academy, library, and training grounds, along with scholars, mystic trainers, and defensive spellcasters charged with protecting the capital.

faq.q: Where can warlocks train in the Mage Quarter?
faq.answer: Warlocks train in secret beneath The Slaughtered Lamb, a tavern in Mage Quarter. In its crypts and hidden cellars, they study fel rituals, summon demons, and train beyond the city guard's scrutiny.

faq.q: What kind of shops are in the Mage Quarter?
faq.answer: Mage Quarter has specialty shops for casters and crafters. You can find tailoring shops such as Duncan's Textiles and Larson Clothiers, alchemy and herbalism merchants, enchanting vendors, pyrotechnic suppliers, and staff merchants.

faq.q: How do you reach the Mage Quarter?
aliases: how to get to mage quarter
faq.answer: Cross a bridge over the Canals from the Trade District or Cathedral Square to reach Mage Quarter, in Stormwind City's southwestern corner.

angles.text: As a Mage, you find your central home in Stormwind here. The Wizard's Sanctum has master trainers and spell reagents.
Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb, warlocks gather in a hidden coven. There, you can train in the dark arts and summon minions in secret.
